name: io.github.sepehr071/torob-mcp
title: Torob
description: Unofficial read-only Torob: compare Iranian shop prices, price history, deal checks and baskets.

environmentVariables.name: TOROB_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for requests to torob.com, or a comma-separated list used one at a time (the next one takes over when one is blocked or unreachable); system proxy settings are ignored. Torob blocks many foreign and cloud IPs, so an Iranian exit may be needed.
